from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
import json
import threading
import time
import io
import requests
import sys
import unittest
from dcat_catalog_check import DcatCatalogCheck
from functools import partial


class TestIntegration(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.server_address = ("", 8000)
        handler = partial(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, directory="tests/data/")
        cls.httpd = HTTPServer(cls.server_address, handler)

        cls.server_thread = threading.Thread(target=cls.httpd.serve_forever)
        cls.server_thread.daemon = True
        cls.server_thread.start()

        cls._wait_for_server("http://localhost:8000")

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls.httpd.shutdown()
        cls.httpd.server_close()
        cls.server_thread.join()

    @staticmethod
    def _wait_for_server(url, timeout=10, interval=0.2):
        """Wait until the server can be reached at the specified URL."""
        start_time = time.time()
        while time.time() - start_time < timeout:
            try:
                response = requests.get(url)
                if response.status_code == 200:
                    return True
            except requests.exceptions.RequestException:
                pass
            time.sleep(interval)
        print(f"Timeout reached: Server at {url} not reachable.")
        return False

    def setUp(self):
        self.dcc = DcatCatalogCheck("http://test.invalid:8000/", "my_api_key")

    def test_rerun_with_old_data(self):
        """When the test is run after a long time all distributions will be
        checked. The number of successfull checks will be increased."""

        # Read previous results
        self.dcc.read_previous_results("tests/data/result-1.jsonl")

        mock_stdout = io.StringIO()
        sys.stdout = mock_stdout
        self.dcc.check_dcat_catalog("http://localhost:8000/catalog-1.ttl")
        sys.stdout = sys.__stdout__

        output = mock_stdout.getvalue()
        json_objects = [json.loads(line) for line in output.splitlines()]

        self.assertEqual(len(json_objects), 1)

        self.assertEqual(json_objects[0].get("num_good_checks"), 2)
